# The unequal-split Wilkinson (MWPD, K = 1.5): port 3 takes K^2 = 2.25 times port 2's power. The arms differ, so the
# ring's gap sits off the input's axis, and each output leaves through its quarter-wave transformer; the resistor of
# Z0 (K + 1/K) on R2-R3 still lands across the gap with no line.
